seo.title: Port Vila homeless help - No Home Help
seo.description: Verified shelter, food, health, safety, legal and social support for people experiencing homelessness in Port Vila.

page.heading: PORT VILA - HOMELESS HELP
page.urgent: Police emergency: 111 on Digicel or 1111 on Vodafone. Hospital emergency: 112. Violence crisis and safe-house line: 161.
page.notice: Information and availability can change. Call before travelling when possible. A listing does not guarantee a bed, meal, appointment, benefit, treatment or job.
page.intro: No general walk-in homeless shelter is publicly listed for Port Vila. Women and children escaping violence can call the Vanuatu Women's Centre on 161 for confidential crisis support and safe-house referral. For other urgent needs, contact the Ministry of Justice and Community Services or Vanuatu Red Cross and explain the situation.
page.footer: Main sources: Vanuatu Women's Centre, Ministry of Justice and Community Services, Office of the Public Solicitor, Vila Central Hospital, Vanuatu Family Health Association and Vanuatu Red Cross.

entries.title: Vanuatu Women's Centre crisis line
entries.description: Free confidential crisis counselling, legal support, safety planning and safe-house referral for women and children affected by violence.
entries.address: Phone service and Port Vila office
entries.how_to_access: Call 161. Use Police 111 or 1111 if there is immediate danger.

entries.title: Vila Central Hospital emergency
entries.description: Public hospital emergency care for serious illness or injury.
entries.how_to_access: Call 112 or attend the emergency department.

entries.title: Vanuatu Women's Centre safe-house referral
entries.description: Confidential safe accommodation may be arranged for women and children escaping family or sexual violence after a safety assessment.
entries.how_to_access: Call 161. Do not attempt to locate a confidential safe house directly.

entries.title: Vanuatu Red Cross Society
entries.description: Humanitarian, health and disaster assistance. Support depends on assessed need and current programmes; it is not a guaranteed daily food or shelter service.
entries.how_to_access: Contact the society and explain the need. Use emergency numbers for immediate danger.

entries.title: Vila Central Hospital
entries.description: Main referral hospital in Port Vila for emergency and specialist medical care.
entries.how_to_access: Attend the emergency department for urgent care or call 112.

entries.title: Vanuatu Family Health Association
entries.description: Sexual and reproductive health information and clinical services in Port Vila.
entries.how_to_access: Call before visiting and ask about costs and appointment requirements.

entries.title: Mindcare Clinic
entries.description: Mental-health support through Vila Central Hospital.
entries.how_to_access: Call the hospital and ask for extension 1081. Use emergency care if there is immediate risk.

entries.title: Office of the Public Solicitor
entries.description: Legal assistance for people in need, including family law, maintenance, custody, domestic-violence protection orders and some civil or criminal matters.
entries.how_to_access: Call 23450 or 33160 and ask about eligibility and intake.

entries.title: Vanuatu Women's Centre
entries.description: Free confidential counselling, legal advice, accompaniment and referrals to police, courts, hospitals and safe housing for survivors of domestic violence, sexual assault and child abuse.
entries.how_to_access: Call 161 or the office on 25674 or 24000.

entries.title: Police Family Protection Unit
entries.description: Police unit for family violence and protection matters.
entries.how_to_access: Call 22222 or 555 2948 and ask for extensions 2806 or 2834. Use emergency Police 111 or 1111 if unsafe now.

entries.title: Child Protection Focal Point
entries.description: Crisis support, legal advice and referrals concerning child protection.
entries.how_to_access: Call and explain the child's immediate safety needs.
